prompt: Sources with candidates:
- tenant_orders - Orders of every tenant; each caller reads only its own tenants' rows.
A query from tenant_orders can use none of the other listed sources.
- payroll_ledger - Payroll ledger: one row per salary payment.
Its doc begins: "Payroll ledger: one row per salary payment. Finance only."
A query from payroll_ledger can use none of the other listed sources.
- shipments - Every shipment, open to every caller.
A query from shipments can use none of the other listed sources.
<targets>
Target 1 (measure): "freight cost total"
From tenant_orders:
[1] tenant_order_total (measure, number; source tenant_orders): Sum of order totals.
From payroll_ledger:
[2] payroll_gross (measure, number; source payroll_ledger): Gross payroll paid to staff.
From shipments:
[3] carrier_charge (measure, number; source shipments): Carrier charge for the shipments, in US dollars.
</targets>
Also in this group:
[4] total (dimension, number; source tenant_orders): (no doc; name in words: total) | added because: tenant_order_total is computed from it
[5] gross (dimension, number; source payroll_ledger): (no doc; name in words: gross) | added because: payroll_gross is computed from it
[6] charge (dimension, number; source shipments): (no doc; name in words: charge) | added because: carrier_charge is computed from it
Reply with one JSON object and nothing else:

{"picks": [{"target": <target number>, "candidates": [<candidate numbers, best first>], "best": <the one candidate number that best answers the target>, "reason": "<one short sentence>", "readings": <true only when you picked the same field on several sources because the question could mean either set of rows>}, ...], "caveats": ["<one short sentence>", ...]}

Give one element per target, with an empty "candidates" list for a target this group cannot answer. Use only the candidate numbers listed under that target or under "Also in this group". List "candidates" best first; "best" is one of them, the field on the source whose doc best matches the population or breakdown the target and the question ask for. Leave "readings" out unless it is true.
